title: Mega Man 9
intro: A route through the Robot Masters, the utility items worth collecting, and the final stages. Read the introduction for the controls and systems specific to this game.
facts: Weapons, utility items and final stages
primer: Mega Man’s main campaign returns to the Mega Man 2 controls: no slide and no charged Buster. Rush Coil is available at the start; Rush Jet is awarded after five Robot Master clears.
E-Tanks are one-use full-health refills. Open the weapon menu before the next hit could kill you. They are not refillable Sub Tanks.
There are no hidden permanent health or armor pickups. Bolts buy supplies and conveniences at the shop. Legacy Collection 2 also includes Proto Man’s separate campaign and the original extra modes.
routeIntro: Galaxy gives a manageable Buster start. Follow the complete weakness loop; Jewel Satellite is especially useful against ordinary enemies.

returnIntro: Collect the listed utility items before entering the fortress. Ordinary energy, lives and tanks are consumable supplies, not X-style permanent health upgrades.
completionText: Clear all Robot Masters, check the utility items listed above, and refill the weapons needed for the final stages.

sections.title: Shop and safe preparation
paragraphs: Buy E-Tanks, an Energy Balancer and Beat rescue supplies before the fortress. Beat saves you from a pit while a rescue remains; it does not make spikes safe.
Hornet Chaser retrieves distant items. Jewel Satellite blocks many small enemies and projectiles, so use it while crossing long enemy-filled routes.

sections.title: Wily’s fortress
paragraphs: Stage 1: use Tornado Blow for wind platforms and Concrete Shot to freeze magma beams. Stage 2: Rush Jet and Coil help with the long gaps. Preserve enough energy for the rooms ahead.

Use Laser Trident against the Wily stage 1 multi-part shark. In stage 2, shoot the Mega Man copies only when the vulnerable one is visible. Black Hole Bomb damages the Twin Devil’s exposed crossing eye in stage 3.
Wily Machine: return its eggs with the Buster, then use Concrete Shot on the next form. Capsule: use Plug Ball or Hornet Chaser when Wily appears.

sections.title: Proto Man and extra modes
paragraphs: Proto Man can slide, charge and block frontal shots while jumping, but takes more damage and knockback. His mobility tools replace Rush. This is a separate save and a harder first-playthrough choice.
The Fake Man stage and Endless/Time Attack modes are optional collection extras. Finish the main route before using them as completion targets.
